data.text: Before we choose, how about a 10-ton limit each this month? That gives each of us $10,000 and leaves 50 tons. From 50, either natural outcome brings the lake back to 100 next month, so we can repeat this without risking collapse. Taking more might pay once, but it cuts into everyone’s future income. Since catches are revealed afterward, we can check that everyone keeps the agreement. John, would you agree to 10 tons each?
